name: Luminous Origami Canyon
description: A canyon whose walls are folded like giant origami, each crease glowing with soft pastel light.
prompt: Massive canyon with walls formed from colossal origami folds — sharp geometric facets in pale pink, lavender, mint, and peach. Each fold emits a gentle inner glow, casting subtle light into the canyon floor. A narrow river of liquid light runs through. Crisp lines, paper‑texture detail, magical atmosphere, 8K.
caption: Folded light, unfolded wonder 📐✨ #OrigamiCanyon
